name: smooth-accordion
title: Smooth Accordion
description: A stack of disclosures with panels that grow to their content, single or multiple mode, and full keyboard navigation.

props.name: items
props.description: The items, top to bottom: { id, title, content }.

props.name: type
props.description: single keeps one item open, multiple lets several stay open.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Ids of the items that are open first.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Lets the open item in single mode be closed again.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the open ids whenever they change.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds the open and close take.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
